workspace: HOME_ROOT_OBJECT_XY_V3; original initial home root XY offset [-0.10,0]m; no mid-run reset or root command

first_panel.qualification: One single-environment complete late-decision episode per scene; new reference pattern also qualified in two environments before production
first_panel.assignment: action index=(parent_index_zero_based+repetition_index_zero_based)%4; odd repetitions reverse each pair's slot order
first_panel.purpose: Action condition panel; existing physical parents are not counted twice

prospective_panel.offsets_and_assignment: Same first-panel rule, using parent index modulo8
prospective_panel.DEV_use: Zero-update evaluation; never normalization, hyperparameter selection or weight fitting

ARX_strengthening: TRAIN-only feature standardization, previous observed/predicted increment, scaled relative action, known source-age mask and elapsed time; recursive future rollout, never future actual states or ages
primary_prediction_metric: Per-parent TCP position coordinate RMSE at horizons1,8,16; report pooled and each independent DEV parent, all arms and negative fields
action_information_test: Scaled-action vs matched NO_ACTION on independently held-out parents before observing action response; keep raw arm and stronger rule baseline
limitations: Not exact counterfactual branching, oracle regret, task success or formal Actor training; decision/control value needs subsequent prospective execution
safety_owner_and_original_window: Unchanged; user uncapped engineering revision applies only to cumulative engineering limits
